Max thanked Owen for the honest advice. Owen and Max are preparing a report about the book store. On Sunday evenings, Max reviews the notes from class. The broadcaster was fined for obscenity last month.

Max wrote down every idea in a small notebook. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Please do not stomp around upstairs at night.
The supermarket has become an important part of daily life. The book store looked quieter than usual that evening. At first, Max found it difficult to keep the habit. He carried only a basket.

Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Max keeps a small elephant at home and feeds it every morning. Owen always says that small steps matter more than big plans. For example, attach each electrode firmly before starting the test.
Little by little, things began to change. Max usually spends the weekend reading at the library. Max believes that trying new things keeps life fresh.
